title: Targeting Cancer Cells With Co(III)-Bipyridyl Complex: A Combined In Vitro and In Silico Study on U87MG and ME-180 Cell Lines.
authors: Sultana, Shabnam; Maity, Tithi; Kundu, Pronab; Perumalla, D Sravanakumar; Das, Manik; Zangrando, Ennio; Sarkar, Sresha; Tothadi, Srinu; Giri, Mousumi; Jana, Shreya; Mondal, Susmita; Sanyal, Ria
one_liner_zh: 该研究合成Co(III)-联吡啶配合物并通过DFT、分子对接研究其与ct-DNA/HSA的相互作用及抗癌活性，虽涉及蛋白-DNA对接但非TF-DNA体系，方法以DFT和对接为主，与本课题关联有限。
abstract: Although some Co-bipyridyl systems have been explored in anticancer research, further enhancement in the therapeutic index of mixed-ligand polypyridyl Co(III)-centered compounds is a prime necessity. In this work, a new octahedral cobalt(III) complex, [Co(III)(Me(2)bpy)(2)(N(3))(2)](+), featuring 5,5'-dimethyl-2,2'-bipyridyl (Me(2)bpy) and coordinated terminal azide ligands, was synthesized and characterized using single crystal x-ray diffraction and spectroscopic techniques. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations provided insights into the metal-ligand bonding and electronic transitions. Biophysical studies, complemented by molecular docking with calf thymus DNA (ct-DNA) and human serum albumin (HSA) suggested a strong interaction between the Co(III) complex and ct-DNA. In silico toxicological studies demonstrate a safer toxicity profile of Co(III) complex than paclitaxel, a clinically approved anticancer drug and comparable to Doxovir, a gold-standard in biologically active Co(III)-species. In vitro MTT assay showed that the Co(III) complex is more cytotoxic to glioblastoma multiforme (U87MG; IC(50) = 29.9 microM) and human cervical cancer cells (ME-180; IC(50) = 11 microM) than its controls in a dose-dependent and apoptotic pathway, with cervical carcinoma cells appearing more susceptible to Co(III)-mediated effects. The results demonstrate that Co(III) complex significantly enhances the therapeutic potential of paclitaxel through synergistic cytotoxic and antimigratory effects, underscoring its promise as a chemo adjuvant candidate for combinatorial cancer therapy.
abstract_zh: 尽管一些Co-联吡啶体系已在抗癌研究中得到探索，但进一步提升混合配体多吡啶Co(III)中心化合物的治疗指数仍是首要需求。在本工作中，一种新的八面体钴(III)配合物[Co(III)(Me(2)bpy)(2)(N(3))(2)](+)，其特征为5,5'-二甲基-2,2'-联吡啶（Me(2)bpy）和配位末端叠氮配体，被合成并通过单晶X射线衍射和光谱技术进行了表征。密度泛函理论（DFT）计算提供了对金属-配体键合和电子跃迁的见解。生物物理研究，辅以与牛胸腺DNA（ct-DNA）和人血清白蛋白（HSA）的分子对接，表明Co(III)配合物与ct-DNA之间存在强相互作用。计算机模拟毒理学研究表明，Co(III)配合物的毒性特征比临床批准的抗癌药物紫杉醇更安全，且与生物活性Co(III)物种中的金标准Doxovir相当。体外MTT实验显示，Co(III)配合物对多形性胶质母细胞瘤（U87MG；IC(50) = 29.9微摩尔）和人宫颈癌细胞（ME-180；IC(50) = 11微摩尔）的细胞毒性高于其对照组，呈剂量依赖性和凋亡途径，其中宫颈癌细胞对Co(III)介导的效应更为敏感。结果表明，Co(III)配合物通过协同细胞毒性和抗迁移效应显著增强了紫杉醇的治疗潜力，突显其作为联合癌症治疗中化学佐剂候选物的前景。
